## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 阿西诺项目的学术背景不在于某一座“柱廊庭院”本身，而在于中国古典考古研究开始以长期田野项目的方式进入希腊本土。对古典城市而言，真正重要的问题包括聚落布局、公共与居住空间、城防、区域交通以及多期城市演变。2026年首季只是建立基线，尚不足以提出重大历史重构。

**English.** The significance of the Arsinoe project lies less in a single peristyle building than in the establishment of a long-term Sino-Greek field programme within mainland Classical archaeology. The larger questions concern settlement organization, public and domestic space, fortification, regional connectivity, and diachronic urban change. The first 2026 season establishes a baseline rather than a major historical reinterpretation.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 2026年首季联合发掘扩展既有探方，进一步确认一座带柱廊庭院的方形建筑及其多期使用，并出土钱币、陶器、建筑陶构件和动物遗存。其意义主要在中希长期田野合作与资料生产，而不是单一“大发现”。

**English.** The first 2026 season expanded earlier trenches and clarified a square building with a peristyle courtyard, successive use phases, coins, ceramics, architectural terracottas, and faunal remains.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 该项目的重要性主要体现在学术制度史与国际合作：中国学者开始在希腊古典文明核心地区持续获取一手田野资料，并参与材料采集、问题提出和知识生产。就单季考古发现本身而言，其全球理论突破仍有待后续发掘。

**English.** Its main significance lies in the history of scholarship and international collaboration: Chinese researchers are now generating primary field data in a core region of Classical archaeology and participating directly in framing research questions. The global interpretive significance of the first excavation season itself remains to be established through future work.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

**尚无同行评议论文 | No peer-reviewed publication yet.**

[Hellenic Ministry of Culture. (2026, October 16). *Greek-Chinese archaeological research at Angelokastro in Aetolia-Acarnania*.](https://www.culture.gov.gr/el/Information/SitePages/view.aspx?nID=5816)

**现有资料内容（中文）。** 2026年首季成果尚无同行评议论文，主要依据希腊文化部的项目报告。报告确认了柱廊庭院建筑、多期使用和相关遗物，但这一阶段的主要意义是建立长期田野资料基础，而不是已经形成新的古典城市史解释。

**What the current source shows (English).** The first 2026 season has not yet produced a peer-reviewed publication and is documented primarily through the Hellenic Ministry of Culture project report. The report establishes a peristyle building, multiple use phases and associated finds, but the main contribution at this stage is the creation of a long-term field-data base rather than a new historical interpretation of the city.
